prerequisites: Methodologies for identifying innovation needs - e.g. recommended literature for preparation: "The Design Thinking Playbook by Michael Lewrick"

learning_outcomes.text: Students can compare and discuss various financing methods.
Students can develop a business model and critically evaluate it.
Students can derive suitable business models and drive a founding process.
Students identify customer needs and develop business models from them.
Students organize themselves into working groups according to their abilities and strengths. They defend their work results before an expert jury.
Students independently recognize opportunities for business ideas, develop them further, inspire and convince other expert individuals.

syllabus_topics: Common methods for generating business models
Legal forms & Formalities - The official path to founding

assessment_methods.method: Portfolio examination: Case study - Customer benefit (presentation 15 min + written elaboration 5-10 pages)
Portfolio examination: Case study - "Sales channels / Marketing strategy & Legal form" (presentation 15 min + written elaboration 5-10 pages)
Portfolio examination: "Final Pitch" (presentation 10 min + written elaboration 20-30 pages)

assessment_rules: The portfolio examination comprises 100 points and consists of three presentations. A maximum of 30 points can be achieved with the first two presentations each, and a maximum of 40 points can be achieved with the last presentation.
